theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), C.boundary = 0 → ∀ F : Finset (Euclid P), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ e ∈ F, LocallyIntegrableOn (g e) (Ioi 0)) → (∀ e ∈ F, ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), ∃ k : ℤ, g e t = k) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, C ω = ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), g e t * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)) → ∃ m : Euclid P → ℤ, ∑ e ∈ F, m e = 0 ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, C ω = ∑ e ∈ F, (m e : ℝ) * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)
